name: s3ListBucket
syntax: s3ListBucket(bucket [, prefix, maxKeys, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Lists the objects in an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket, optionally filtered by a key prefix. Returns an array of structs with key, size, lastModified, eTag, storageClass and isDirectory. If a key prefix is configured for the application, returned keys have the prefix stripped.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to list.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Optional key prefix to filter objects by (e.g. "logs/").

params.name: maxKeys
params.description: Optional maximum number of keys to return.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: List objects under a prefix
examples.description: Returns objects whose keys begin with the prefix.
